description.value: CICIDS2017 dataset contains benign and the most up-to-date common attacks, which resembles the true real-world data (PCAPs). It also includes the results of the network traffic analysis using CICFlowMeter with labeled flows based on the time stamp, source, and destination IPs, source and destination ports, protocols and attack (CSV files).

dataset.licensing_note: The pinned mirror labels its license as 'other' and its README requests citation but grants no explicit reuse license; verify rights before redistribution.
dataset.name: CIC-IDS2017

limitations: The original CIC download page requires a contact form; the retained flow records are from the pinned public Hugging Face mirror.

sampling.method: uniform reservoir sample without replacement across source files
